name: Mission-aware minelayer strategy AI
summary: Extends the existing conflict-driven minelayer bot with mission-seeded mine zones, accelerated opening scans, explicit roster filtering, and recovery when assigned minelayers stop making progress.

sources.notes: Adapted the mission initialization, quick-scan, actor filtering, and stuck recovery behavior into the native OpenRA MinelayerBotModule instead of duplicating the full module.

integration.migration_notes: Set InitializingMinefieldActor on mission-specific bot definitions to seed authored defensive zones. QuickScanTickTimes and QuickScanTickAfterInitializing are safe for skirmish use without markers.

evidence: Isolated Debug build of OpenRA.Mods.Cnc/OpenRA.Mods.Common completed with 0 errors.
OpenRA.Utility ra --check-yaml passed with the quick-scan fields enabled on the turtle AI and all bundled RA maps, sequences, and Fluent references validated.

The release-style reuse gate passed isolated builds, the complete RA map and Fluent scan, interface contract checks, pinned-source inventory validation, component graph validation, and exact asset provenance hashes.
